pack.title: Tiny Worlds
pack.tagline: Look closely and find the small textures that most people walk past.
pack.summary: Collect close-up photos of bark, leaves, stones, seeds, or tiny green patches that feel like hidden miniature worlds.

bonus_rules: Get a bonus for three different substrate types.
Get a bonus if one card is a tiny green world.
rules.safety_note: Stay on public paths and sidewalks. Do not climb, reach into private yards, or step into planted areas.
rules.weather_note: Works best after fog, shade, or moisture, but still works year-round if texture is the main lens.

cards.title: Bark texture
cards.prompt: Take a close-up photo of bark that looks detailed or surprising.
cards.adult_prompt: Look for cracks, color shifts, peeling layers, or lichen patches.

cards.title: Leaf detail
cards.prompt: Take a close-up photo of a leaf with strong veins, patterns, or edges.
cards.kid_prompt: Find a leaf with cool lines.

cards.title: Stone pattern
cards.prompt: Take a close-up photo of a rock, wall, or stone surface with pattern or texture.

cards.title: Tiny green world
cards.prompt: Take a close-up photo of something that feels like a tiny green world.
cards.adult_prompt: Moss, lichen, liverwort, algae-like texture, or any micro-scale green patch counts.

cards.title: Seed, flower, or pod detail
cards.prompt: Take a close-up photo of a seed head, flower detail, or pod pattern.
cards.kid_prompt: Find a tiny flower or seed detail.

recap.title: Your tiny worlds recap
recap.success_message: You found three or more tiny worlds.
recap.partial_message: You found some tiny worlds. Another walk can fill the rest.
recap.empty_message: No tiny worlds were saved this time.
highlight_rules: Show each completed texture card with one best photo.
Call out how many different substrate types were found.
